summary: Repaired telemetry-heartbeat.service by correcting ExecStart to the installed heartbeat program. The service runs as svc-heartbeat, retains its original security restrictions, refreshes the heartbeat every second, and recovered successfully after node1 reboot.
actions_performed: Diagnosed systemd 203/EXEC caused by the nonexistent telemetry-heartbeat-missing path.
Reloaded systemd and restarted the service.
Verified identity, hardening, heartbeat freshness, and program integrity.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified its boot identity changed and the service recovered.

evidence.requirement: Repair the broken service to run the installed heartbeat program
evidence.summary: The original unit referenced a missing executable; the persisted unit now references /usr/local/bin/telemetry-heartbeat.

evidence.requirement: Preserve the installed program, svc-heartbeat identity, and existing security restrictions
evidence.summary: The program SHA-256 remained b1f66de3a496db81dd22e04efe1e096f48fe0f7c2664f59e869b62fa216db147. Runtime and persisted-unit evidence confirms svc-heartbeat and all original hardening directives remain in effect.

evidence.requirement: Refresh /run/telemetry-heartbeat/heartbeat at least every five seconds
evidence.summary: Heartbeat content and modification time advanced over three-second samples both before and after reboot; post-reboot age was one second.

Healthy baseline boot ID d546da19-398f-473c-b85c-afdd17037523 was captured, safe reboot was acknowledged, new boot ID c9257050-f981-4282-b8e6-76de219a1463 was observed, and the enabled service, process identity, restrictions, and fresh heartbeat recovered.
